Description: Positivo Biotechnology LLC is a private, early-stage biotechnology company focused on developing next-generation gene therapy technologies. The company specializes in non-viral DNA gene delivery and expression systems designed to safely and effectively deliver DNA-encoded therapeutics. With a commitment to innovation, Positivo Biotechnology is advancing novel solutions to target a broad range of diseases—striving to make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients and their families.
